book.title: Cambridge International AS & A Level Mathematics: Pure Mathematics 1
book.author: Sue Pemberton
book.policy: Book informs the topic sequence and methods. Teaching prose, numerical examples and quick checks are independently written; no book images or exercise text are reproduced.

syllabus.section: 1.7 Differentiation: rational powers, chain rule, chord limits, tangents, normals, monotonicity, stationary points, connected rates and optimisation. No integration, inflexion classification, or required product/quotient rule.

local_syllabus_review.note: Official cover and differentiation scope verified. No formal first-principles differentiation or points-of-inflexion classification is required. The non-turning example only explains why the second-derivative test can be inconclusive. Small-change estimates are a short derivative application, not a separate P3 topic.
